item.text: The Corruption and Crime Commission reviewed a police investigation into an arrest at Hamilton Hill and the preparation of prosecution evidence.
item.support: This investigation examined both the conduct of the officers during the incident, and those who prepared the evidence for prosecution.

item.text: The Commission assessed whether the police investigation's conclusions were reasonably available on the evidence.
item.support: The Commission reviewed IAU's investigation to ensure that the investigation was conducted adequately and IAU's findings were reasonably open on the evidence.

item.text: It concluded that the investigation was comprehensive and formed no opinion of misconduct.
item.support: The Commission has concluded that the IAU investigation was comprehensive.

item.text: The Commission supported introducing police body cameras and planned to seek an update on work addressing prosecution issues after a year.
item.support: In one year's time, the Commission will seek further information from the WA Police Force

item.quote: The Commission has concluded that the IAU investigation was comprehensive.
The conclusions reached by IAU as to the conduct of various officers were open.
